svg.text: Threat model: who might mess around and what happens then
Concept 1 · every card: which door → what happens → this week's lock
A sibling or guest who messes around
long passwords + bcrypt + 10 attempts per minute
Another web page in your browser
the browser, which sends your cookie by itself
all accounts and sessions leak too
household habits readable: when it's empty
git add ., then push to GitHub
Four principles that guide every lock this week
every door is locked; only a
whoever only needs to look gets a
viewer account, the small terminal too
one lock may fail; the next
Honestly: this week the backend only listens on 127.0.0.1, so phones or other laptops on your home Wi-Fi can't knock on it yet.
Module 22 brings the dashboard to the browser, Phase 5 the backend to the internet. The locks go in now, while the house is quiet.
Not locked yet this week: the devices and the MQTT broker (Module 21), and HTTPS (Phase 5).
